messages:
noah_sales: Heads up — EuroBankCorp POC (EU VPC) is blocked during compliance runs. They pinned model `redwood/llm-mid-2024` and immediately hit a deprecation error + intermittent rate limits. Need fast mitigation so they can finish regulator prompts today. acct EBC-77.

lucy_eng: paste the error text and any trace IDs so infra can check replication state.

noah_sales: Error from their on-prem gateway: 
```
ERROR 410 model_deprecated: 'redwood/llm-mid-2024' has been sunset in region eu-west-2
trace=tb9f1c
```
Also seeing 429s from their integration test harness when they parallelize 40 threads.

compliance_bot: customer also submitted a security questionnaire asking about KMS key scope for private inference and whether model routing can be restricted to same-region artifacts.

raj_infra: quick analysis: that model tag was scheduled for deprecation in eu-west-2 after we shifted traffic to a quantized snapshot. eu-west-2 hasn't finished the final artifact promotion. Pinned requests fail instead of falling back.

kate_se: options for short term: (A) swap pin to `redwood/llm-mid-stable` (compatible older snapshot) (B) allow header-based transparent fallback: `X-Allow-Fallback: true` (C) route this tenant to eu-central replica via VPC peering (needs customer network consent). Which is quickest?

noah_sales: customer prefers minimal changes on their side. Header seems OK if we can guarantee same-scope KMS usage.

raj_infra: header is fastest. Note on KMS: for Private deployments we route encryption keys via their KMS endpoint; header-driven fallback stays within tenant scope. Example curl for them: 
```
curl -X POST https://vpc.redwood/eu-west-2/infer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Allow-Fallback: true" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/llm-mid-2024","input":"<regulatory-prompt>"}'
```
Backpressure still possible if they exceed quota.

kate_se: pricing note for quantized snapshot: ~0.5x token cost, slightly higher throughput. If they accept that, we can suggest switching to `redwood/llm-mid-quant-2024` permanently.

noah_sales: customer also asked: will the fallback change RLHF/quality? any small eval we can run to reassure them?

lucy_eng: run a short eval of 20 prompts between models and report normalized BLEU/ROUGE-ish scores + a couple of regulator-sensitive prompts. I can run that in ~1h.

compliance_bot: security Q: are model logs stored in our control plane? customer requires logs staying in their VPC for 30 days.

raj_infra: private deployment keeps inference logs in customer-managed storage if configured; for hosted we redact and store short-term. I'll draft the security note.

deploy_bot: infra note: I'll schedule a one-off mirror of `llm-mid-quant-2024` to eu-west-2 (ticket INF-9002) but ETA ~36-48h.

noah_sales: action items: 
- kate_se: send pricing delta + quick quote for 1-week dedicated trial and quantized routing (ETA 2h)
- raj_infra: enable header fallback for tenant EBC-77 (ETA 1h) and confirm KMS boundary remains tenant-only
- lucy_eng: run 20-prompt eval comparing pinned model vs quantized snapshot and post results (ETA 1h 15m)
- noah_sales: coordinate with customer to accept header change and run tests at 15:30 CET

kate_se: ACK. Drafting quote now, will include pilot discount options and note that sustained rps >25 will need dedicated pool.

raj_infra: header fallback enabled for EBC-77 at 13:08 UTC. Confirmed fallback stays within tenant KMS scope.

lucy_eng: eval finished: 20 prompts — quality delta small (avg quality score 0.96 vs 1.0 baseline). I'll paste sample outputs to the internal eval doc.

noah_sales: customer ran their suite at 15:35 CET with header. No 410s, two requests returned fallback model but acceptable. They asked for written confirmation about logs staying in their VPC and an ETA on permanent mirror.

raj_infra: INF-9002 created to mirror `llm-mid-quant-2024` to eu-west-2; ETA 36h, will update when done.

compliance_bot: circulated the KMS/log response to customer. They want a short note on retention policy — please attach.

kate_se: quote sent to EBC-77 including 7-day dedicated pool option, pilot discount, and cost diff for quantized routing.

deploy_bot: muting 429 alerts for EBC-77 while they use trial config. Will unmute after mirror completes.

noah_sales: Customer accepted header workaround and pilot quote; scheduling follow-up call after mirror. Thanks team — closing thread once INF-9002 completes and mirror validated. :white_check_mark:
